recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a young woman with long dark hair, posed against a solid vibrant purple backdrop. Her face is heavily adorned with colorful, glossy stickers (butterflies, stars, smiley faces), and she has small letter blocks resting on her tongue. She wears a fuzzy pink tank top and plaid bottoms, with arms crossed in a defiant, deadpan expression.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark hair creates a vertical anchor against the flat purple field.
The chaotic, multi-colored stickers contrast with the minimalist, monochromatic background.
The small, white letter blocks on the tongue serve as the central focal point of the face.
coreInvariants: Solid, saturated purple background without gradients.
Glossy, 3D-effect stickers applied directly to the skin.
Deadpan facial expression with tongue slightly extended.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally framed medium shot, subject occupies roughly 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the cluster of stickers and the tongue.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the stickers on the cheeks, follows the tongue/letter blocks, and ends at the crossed arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample, uniform purple space surrounding the subject on all sides.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with soft, diffused lighting on the subject to maintain skin texture.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high-contrast between subject and background

letterConstructionRules: Letters appear as individual black characters on small white square cubes
Arranged horizontally across the surface of the tongue
Slightly irregular alignment to mimic physical placement
characterSpecificRedesigns: Monospaced appearance within the cube boundaries
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: N/A - Single instance of prop-based lettering

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, neutral sans-serif look of toy letter blocks.
Provides a similar sturdy, utilitarian feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a young woman with long dark wavy hair, arms crossed, wearing a fuzzy pink top against a solid purple studio background. Her face should have a variety of colorful glossy stickers on her cheeks and forehead.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four small white plastic cubes resting on her tongue, each containing one black sans-serif letter to spell a short word.

verificationChecks: Are the stickers glossy and appearing to sit on the skin?
Is the purple background completely flat and uniform?
Are the letter blocks rendered as 3D objects rather than flat text?

mustAchieve: Tactile contrast between fuzzy fabric and glossy stickers

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the tongue blocks look physically present, not photoshopped.
Check that the purple background doesn't have distracting shadows.
Verify the stickers have a slight 3D thickness/sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Solid Color Background] + [Subject with Mixed Media Face Decor] + [Prop-based Lettering on Tongue] = Gen-Z Aesthetic Portrait.
